gen-gf-gorditas-author: Gorditas spreads its round, untilted letters apart like loosened rope. Author, a serif, does the quieter work, with a slight swell on its bowls that suits paragraphs better than the heading's chunky display swagger ever could.
gen-gf-gorditas-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One slows everything to a leisurely walk, its curvy serif letters feeling gloriously unclamped. BhuTuka Expanded One is the strongest half here, while Gorditas holds its rope-like round letters apart above it.
gen-gf-gorditas-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Authoritative but loose-limbed, Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart. Its pipe-cleaner feel is the pair's strongest quality, and it plays well against the rope-strand roundness of Gorditas above it.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-gambetta: Gambetta reads bookish and graceful, with wide channels leading into each counter and a stroke weight that shifts noticeably without ever turning dramatic. Gambetta's gentle serif rhythm settles under Grandstander, whose cable-like lines bend into tall, open shapes that stay bold.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-abyssinica-sil: Grandstander skims along on lines that never swell or thin, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. And Abyssinica SIL, a serif with a quiet brushed-watercolor shift in weight, gives that bold play a literary, classic landing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-cambo: Cambo is a refined, bookish serif with a modest thick-thin rhythm. Grandstander is best at pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, held open and bold, while Cambo does its finest work with that low-key variation across each word.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-fanwood-text: Bookish through and through, Fanwood Text brings a large-eyed lowercase and gentle swelling on its curves. And Grandstander's open, constant-width letters keep things lively above it, so a long read stays literary and easygoing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Grandstander keeps its letters held open, with plain constant-width lines, short ascenders and a tall x-height. Holtwood One SC, a serif, answers with towering, nearly closed curves.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-manuale: Manuale carries a traditional, editorial feel, with a large-eyed lowercase and moderate contrast. But Grandstander does its best work with zero stroke modulation, while Manuale offers the slight heft change of a stone-carved inscription.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-naskh-arabic: Chunky, open and bold, Grandstander has curves as thick as its stems. Noto Naskh Arabic, a refined serif with a very tall x-height, would suit a slightly larger size than the heading's tall lowercase might suggest.
